pages.title: Role in Progression
pages.text: Nascent Soul techniques reach supreme divine arts and life-preserving secrets: Spirit Realm sword formations from the Qingyuan Sword Art, divine-sense attacks, divided-soul incarnations, a second Nascent Soul, Magnetic Origin Divine Light, spirit communion, and Nascent Yang Flame. These currently serve as rules data for future high-level method learning, divine sense, and combat systems.

pages.title: Qingyuan Sword Art and Dispersal
pages.text: The Spring Dawn Sword Formation is the opening Spirit Realm divine art for layers 13-15, concealing lethal force within wood-aligned illusions. The Azure Coiling Sword Formation is the ultimate formation for layers 16-18, shaping seventy-two flying swords into an azure dragon. The third dispersal of the Threefold Essence-Reforming Art makes the final preparation for forming a Nascent Soul, with an extreme cost on failure.

pages.title: Great Development Art and Divine Sense
pages.text: The seven layers of the Great Development Art train and divide divine sense. Thousandfold Divine Sense handles many complex actions at once; Spirit-Shocking Thorn and Mind-Loss Thorn attack the soul; Soul-Dividing Art splits off a second primordial spirit; Five Ghosts Soul-Locking Grand Art seals and suppresses, while Seven Emotions Art manipulates emotion.

pages.title: Second Nascent Soul and Incarnations
pages.text: External Incarnation, Profound Shepherd Nascent Transformation Grand Art, and Unity Art form the second-Nascent-Soul and incarnation route. Profound Soul Demon-Refining Grand Art, Spirit Attachment Art, and Shape-Shifting Art involve possession, demon-beast symbiosis, and bodily disguise, making them suitable for future soul risk, shared damage, and infiltration mechanics.

pages.title: Life Preservation and Supreme Arts
pages.text: Magnetic Origin Divine Light requires all five spiritual roots and counters Five-Element attacks. Spirit-Communion Art speaks with ancient spirit beasts, while Thought-Thunder condenses lightning from divine sense. Body-Dissolving Transformation, Tribulation-Transmuting Grand Art, and Soul-Restoring Art preserve life at the cost of realm loss, grave injury, bodily sacrifice, or memory. Nascent Yang Flame is a Nascent Soul cultivator's bonded true flame.
